title.zh: 授权菲律宾共和国总统Elpidio Quirino阁下接受法兰西共和国政府在其担任菲律宾副总统期间授予的法兰西荣誉军团军官勋位的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing His Excellency, Elpidio Quirino, President of the Republic of the Philippines, to Accept the Decoration of “Grand Officer of the Legion of Honor of the Republic of France” Conferred Upon Him When He was Vice-President of the Philippines by the Government of the Republic of France
title.orig: An Act Authorizing His Excellency, Elpidio Quirino, President of the Republic of the Philippines, to Accept the Decoration of “Grand Officer of the Legion of Honor of the Republic of France” Conferred Upon Him When He was Vice-President of the Philippines by the Government of the Republic of France

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_421_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: For the purpose of promoting international friendship and understanding, His Excellency, Elpidio Quirino, President of the Republic of the Philippines, is authorized to accept the decoration of "Grand Officer of in Legion of Honor of the Republic of France," conferred upon him, when he was Vice-President of the Philippines, by the Government of the Republic of France, and to wear the corresponding insignia.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1949.
